mapper.sql: SELECT d.DATASOURCE_ID, d.DATASOURCE_CODE, d.DATASOURCE_NAME, d.DB_TYPE, d.CONNECTION_TYPE, d.HOST, d.PORT, d.DATABASE_NAME, d.SCHEMA_NAME, d.USERNAME, d.PASSWORD_ENCRYPTED, d.CONNECTION_TIMEOUT, d.QUERY_TIMEOUT, d.MAX_POOL_SIZE, d.USE_YN, d.CREATED_AT, d.CREATED_BY, d.UPDATED_AT, d.UPDATED_BY, d.DELETED_AT, d.DELETED_BY, uc.NAME AS CREATED_BY_NAME, uu.NAME AS UPDATED_BY_NAME, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EXTERNAL_QUERY q WHERE q.DATASOURCE_ID = d.DATASOURCE_ID AND q.DELETED_AT IS NULL) AS QUERY_COUNT FROM TB_EXTERNAL_DATASOURCE d LEFT JOIN TB_USER uc ON d.CREATED_BY = uc.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_USER uu ON d.UPDATED_BY = uu.USERNAME
mapper.select:
WHERE ( d.DATASOURCE_CODE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR d.DATASOURCE_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR d.HOST LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY CASE WHEN d.DATASOURCE_NAME LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, d.DATASOURCE_NAME
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EXTERNAL_DATASOURCE ( DATASOURCE_CODE, DATASOURCE_NAME, DB_TYPE, CONNECTION_TYPE, HOST, PORT, DATABASE_NAME, SCHEMA_NAME, USERNAME, PASSWORD_ENCRYPTED, CONNECTION_TIMEOUT, QUERY_TIMEOUT, MAX_POOL_SIZE, USE_YN, CREATED_BY ) VALUES ( #{datasourceCode}, #{datasourceName}, #{dbType}, #{connectionType}, #{host}, #{port}, #{databaseName}, #{schemaName}, #{username}, #{passwordEncrypted}, COALESCE(#{connectionTimeout}, 5000), COALESCE(#{queryTimeout}, 30000), COALESCE(#{maxPoolSize}, 3), COALESCE(#{useYn}, 'Y'), #{createdBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EXTERNAL_DATASOURCE SET DATASOURCE_NAME = COALESCE(#{datasourceName}, DATASOURCE_NAME), CONNECTION_TYPE = COALESCE(#{connectionType}, CONNECTION_TYPE), HOST = COALESCE(#{host}, HOST), PORT = COALESCE(#{port}, PORT), DATABASE_NAME = COALESCE(#{databaseName}, DATABASE_NAME), SCHEMA_NAME = #{schemaName}, USERNAME = COALESCE(#{username}, USERNAME), CONNECTION_TIMEOUT = COALESCE(#{connectionTimeout}, CONNECTION_TIMEOUT), QUERY_TIMEOUT = COALESCE(#{queryTimeout}, QUERY_TIMEOUT), MAX_POOL_SIZE = COALESCE(#{maxPoolSize}, MAX_POOL_SIZE), USE_YN = COALESCE(#{useYn}, USE_YN), UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE DATASOURCE_ID = #{datasourceId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
UPDATE TB_EXTERNAL_DATASOURCE SET PASSWORD_ENCRYPTED = #{passwordEncrypted}, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE DATASOURCE_ID = #{datasourceId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
UPDATE TB_EXTERNAL_DATASOURCE SET USE_YN = #{useYn}, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE DATASOURCE_ID = #{datasourceId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
UPDATE TB_EXTERNAL_DATASOURCE SET DELETED_BY = #{deletedBy}, DELETED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE DATASOURCE_ID = #{datasourceId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EXTERNAL_QUERY WHERE DATASOURCE_ID = #{datasourceId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
